sheets.name: README
rows: Traceability view for one regulation-to-SHACL generation run.
Generation is frozen before RDF execution; no ship graph or hidden expected outcome is used here.
events.jsonl is append-only; CSV and Excel sheets are derived views.
Static validation passed and the semantic validator accepted the candidate.
No verified canonical term was available; the generator was not allowed to invent one.
Accepted shapes await the separate bulk evaluator.

sheets.name: RUNS
rows: Repair the remaining applicability and encoding errors while preserving all prior instructions. Replace the invented seaInletLocation string/hasValue check with the supplied canonical boolean nltl:nearCentrelineAndWellAftIfPossible = true on each qualifying standard chest and on the required alternative chests. Do not make the alternative shape inherit gs:TRF130StandardInletChestShape or gs:TRF130InletChestShape if that inheritance imposes recommendedChestVolume, seaChestVolume, or iceAccumulationSpaceAboveInlet: the alternative branch must exempt only the volume and height requirements while retaining location, full-capacity discharge connection, inlet/strainer quantities and units, the >=4 strainer-area relationship, and the bounded derived-ratio check.
